summary: DoubleLine Income Solutions Fund filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement covering an at-the-market offering of up to $356 million of common shares, with Foreside Fund Services as distributor and UBS Securities LLC as sub-placement agent under agreements dated October 2, 2026. Sales occur at prevailing NYSE market prices; per-share pricing is not fixed. The fund pays the adviser 1.00% of average daily managed assets monthly and uses leverage equal to 21.87% of total managed assets via borrowings. This is a routine shelf takedown of shares, not a special situation; the arb angle is minimal, though AMC dilution and NAV-overhang pressure bear watching.
